species.abilityAutomation: inactive; manual character scores remain authoritative

class.exportCompatibility: native snapshots carry the canonical contract; portable features retain conventional Android metadata

characterOption.automation: existing behavior only; no new grants or prerequisite handlers

spell.exportCompatibility: portable spell entities retain conventional fields and flat class lists; no new casting behavior

item.sourceInputs: baseitem/itemGroup/magicvariant and type/property/mastery definitions remain materialization inputs
item.exportCompatibility: inventory retains the conventional self-contained DisplayItem projection

monster.exportCompatibility: existing detached monster entity and numeric movement projection; player HP/uses stay independent

referenceModels.status: canonical import storage after copy resolution; no rule/editor/viewer integration
referenceModels.validation: exact pinned site/brew record schema selected by import provenance, before/after inheritance
referenceModels.data: source metadata retained without raw payload duplication; copy provenance stays in record.data

proficiencyGrants.storage: existing source fields or canonical class/character-option proficiency fields
proficiencyGrants.consumers: separate typed structured packages and class display proficiencies; species uses validated source accessor

entries.validation: deep validation at full source import boundary
entries.consumers: generated source entry variants in rendering, typed catalog access, higher-level descriptions and standalone/nested table reference traversal
entries.extensions: generic JSON traversal retained for schema-permitted open metadata and unsupported renderable entry types

attachedSpells.consumers: validated flat UID lists and explicit usage groups; no casting automation

additionalSpells.consumers: validated typed block/list/choice traversal; unsupported mechanics remain diagnostics

limitations: Static direct-import and field-access inventory. Follow aliases, helper calls, projections, and indirect consumers during each family migration. Field names do not prove rule semantics or complete automation.
